plugins.Author: Legends of the Game
plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
Label: Journal
- Re-baseline: pick a date in Settings, and everything recorded before it is re-marked Pre-Plugin, for when some of those dates are known to be wrong. The journal is backed up first.
- Real completions now record seconds, not just the day, so a bad write leaves an unmistakable shared timestamp instead of an ambiguous busy day.
- Rotating backups: a snapshot before any write, when content actually changed and the newest backup is at least 3 days old. Kept to the newest three.
- A twice-monthly recovery point (1st and 15th of each month), held 32 days, independent of the 3-day rotation.

Label: Interface
- Rewrote the Help tab, wrapped to the actual window width in both Classic and Native.
- Fixed the Progression list overlapping its own footer.
- Raised the Native window's minimum width to 956, growing it live if it was already open narrower.
